description: This Java class 'MainViewController' manages different view bindings for the main screen in an Android application, including attaching views like latest view, updates, categories, and settings fragment to a FrameLayout within a RecyclerView.ViewHolder context.

classes.name: MainViewController
classes.description: Controls view binding for main screen components, managing different view types and attaching fragments within a RecyclerView context.

methods.name: MainViewController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with activity context and FrameLayout.

methods.name: bindLatestView
methods.description: Creates and binds the latest view to the frame.

methods.name: bindUpdates
methods.description: Initializes and binds the updates view if not already created.

methods.name: unbindUpdates
methods.description: Unbinds the updates view if it exists.

methods.name: bindCategoriesView
methods.description: Creates and binds the categories view.

methods.name: bindSwapView
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating unimplemented functionality.

methods.name: bindSettingsView
methods.description: Inflates the settings fragment layout into the FrameLayout.
